ko.executive_summary: Qualcomm is establishing its third-largest global AI R&D center in Vietnam while SK Hynix is expanding HBM production in Indiana to access talent and incentives. NVIDIA's strong quarterly results confirm chipmakers have displaced traditional big tech as the primary AI era winners, with Broadcom also expanding its AI position through custom silicon and VMware integration.
key_facts: Qualcomm plans third-largest global AI R&D center in Vietnam
SK Hynix establishing HBM manufacturing in Indiana
NVIDIA confirms chipmaker dominance over big tech in AI era
Broadcom expanding AI position via custom silicon and VMware

implications.text: Chipmakers shifting R&D and manufacturing hubs to Vietnam and US Midwest to reduce supply chain concentration and access regional incentives.
Semiconductor specialists outpacing traditional tech giants as primary beneficiaries of AI infrastructure buildout.
Broadcom's custom silicon strategy combined with VMware acquisition demonstrates move toward end-to-end AI solutions.

ko.counterpoint: Expansion into Vietnam and US construction timelines may face regulatory or geopolitical headwinds.
